conventions: Qubits Q1..Q5 = code q0..q4. TEST split, 1.12M shots per qubit (560k per prepared bit). 1 us = samples 0-499 (paper 'full trace'); 600 ns = 0-299; 400 ns = 0-199. 1 us model = canonical MCMit-CNN (preds_MCMitCNN_pb.npy); 600/400 ns = soft MCMit-CNN, same recipe. HERQULES = per-trace checkpoint (the one in tab:fidelity). Shares are of that qubit's errors unless marked. CIs: error rates Wilson; L +/-1.96 sqrt(N+ + N-); O binomial per configuration; var(T+S) = var(L) + var(O). All CIs statistical; reference/detector systematics given as ranges.

appendix_facts.order_swap: transition before leakage: residual / overlap / unresolved state change move by <= 0.03 pp on every qubit; only the L/T split moves (Q3 L 3.14 -> 1.70 %, T 1.75 -> 3.18 %; Q5 L 1.03 -> 0.89 %, T 5.02 -> 5.16 %): 7.7 % of Q3 prepared-|0> errors are both leaked and step-flagged
appendix_facts.noise_independence: CNN error rate vs late displacement flat within CIs for Q1/Q3/Q5 (both bits); not flat for Q2 (33.7->15.2%) and Q4 prep |1> (e5vstat)
appendix_facts.repro_independent_pipeline: e5vrepro (own demod, frames, detector, late core): L, O, T+S agree within combined CIs for Q3, Q5 (1 us, 400 ns) and the Q1,Q3-Q5 pool
appendix_facts.old_procedure_on_canonical_cnn: 97.41 / 2.44 / 0.16 (near / T1 / amp outlier), vs paper 97.4 / 2.4 / 0.2: the wrong method, not the wrong model, set the shares
appendix_facts.old_rule: near-boundary = P(correct) < 0.6, true for every error; 'T1' = sign test on un-centred halves (cannot fire on Q1/Q3; flags 9.5% of all Q5 prep-|0> shots); 'leakage' = |z(mean|IQ|)|>3 among HybridCNN errors
appendix_facts.late_core_upper_bound: the late-core expectation multiplies the stationary-shot misread rate by ALL prepared-b shots (incl. shots that decayed or leaked inside the window) and its reference set contains a few shots that changed state and came back; O is therefore an upper bound and S / T+S lower bounds. For Q2 (SNR ~1.2) the late core is impure (|0> and |1> late clouds overlap) and O is loose.
